d: A desperate Big Al pushes Hiro to the limit, Chris looks for big gear to salvage his season, while PJ & Andy’s camp has a mini-revolt.
Big Al’s plans are hurt by no-show staff, PJ’s wife questions if mining is worth it for their family, and Ed & Riley hit their stride - til they run out of fuel.
PJ & Andy’s main investor gives them an ultimatum, Chris discovers a clue that could lead to a huge payout, and Ed & Riley’s season might end early.
Breakdowns threaten Al’s chance of a profit, desperate PJ & Andy start a night shift, and Ed & Riley make a last ditch effort to prove themselves as miners.
The gold mining season begins and newcomer Big Al is off to a great start with a big gold haul.  But Bernie struggles with his rookie crew and Ken can’t get his sluicer, The Beast, up and running.

A flooding river threatens Ken’s gold camp and after a screaming match one of his workers quits.  Karl hasn’t even started sluicing while Big Al goes after 'smart' gold, but his machines keep breaking down.

Ken wonders if his gold camp is cursed while Karl copes with crew mistakes & design flaws in the big machine his Dad built.  Bernie packs it in at McDame Creek and moves his whole operation - hoping his luck will change.
After Beat and Sam build a beautiful home in Alberta, the clients egg them on to a paint ball battle on their acreage.
Timber Kings: Behind the Sawdust captures the world’s best log home craftsmen like never before! This one-hour special takes you behind the scenes.
Beat takes on one of the most perilous builds of his career, a luxury twin-turreted vacation home on the edge of 100-foot cliff.
In Alberta, Beat is tasked with building one man’s dream home on the picturesque farmland where he grew up.
A reluctant Joel joins forces with his wife to construct a backyard obstacle course that he hopes will prepare them for one Tough Mudder of a race.

Peter helps restore a Manitoba couple’s love for logs by building a home to replace the one they tragically lost to fire. Meanwhile, the renovation of a neighborhood bar nearly drives Bryan Jr. to drink.
Bryan Jr. whips up an outdoor kitchen before hitting the beach in search of the ultimate driftwood bar.
Joel takes on the mother of all builds – a 20,000-sq./ft. Pennsylvania mansion complete with walk through tree, hand-carved totem pole and 3-story spiral log staircase.
Peter may have met his match when he builds a mountainside ski cabin for a client experienced in log-home building.
Beat builds a lottery winner’s 7,000-sq.ft. dream home in northern Alberta. Meanwhile, Peter must beg, borrow and steal to deliver on two high profile entryways for Canada’s Winter Games.
Beat battles a stuck truck in the middle of the night, then builds in darkness to meet his deadline on a home in northern Ontario.
Joel pinch hits in Oregon, by building a home he’s never seen before using a crane he hopes he’ll never see again.
